description:
LEVELS OF ASSISTANCE Five power levels to best manage the support, guaranteeing exceptional performance to tackle any type of route. MOTOR The REAR HUB rear hub motor develops a power of 250W and a torque of 45 Nm at a weight of just over 3 kg. Compact and versatile, it does not require any special ordinary maintenance. BATTERY The ultra slim 360 Wh intube battery is inserted and perfectly integrated into the downtube. Thanks to its small size it is completely invisible, and the weight and handling of the frame benefit from it. Autonomy up to 60 km in excellent path/cyclist conditions.

BE GREEN TECHNOLOGIES The 28″ HPG aluminum frame with fully integrated battery is combined with the hub motor for particularly smooth and easy handling. The ultra slim battery is fully inserted into the downtube, and easily rechargeable via the dedicated charging jack. The 8-speed Shimano gearbox and hydraulic brake contribute to riding comfort. The standard front basket is fixed directly to the steering for safer handling even with a loaded basket. The standard equipment also includes mudguards, luggage rack and lighting system, for a perfect city set up. IDEAL FOR ACTIVE is designed for daily journeys on asphalt and light dirt roads, for moving in traffic, reaching work or running errands in the city centre. PERFECT FOR YOU IF For those looking for a versatile and comfortable vehicle, perfect for moving around the city with ease. Thanks to its lightweight design and compact structure, it is perfect for use both in the city and on light dirt tracks.
